ns2:course.label: Spec Topics in Design Courses
ns2:course.description: Topics and subject matter to be published in course listings. Class Materials Fee may apply. See Class Schedule. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours in a semester, to a maximum of 12 total hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing in Art and Design.
